referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Urban Autocare website in Denver, Colorado uses dark automotive photo with orange service headline and many location actions. Navigation is multi-location phone utility above main navigation. Its page moves through location utility, shop photo opening, service promise, six-location selector, service photography, warranty and trust explanation, reviews, schedule close, with services and locations are separate navigational groups. repair photos and shop scenes in robust horizontal bands. Transferable mechanics are six-location switchboard, orange-on-dark hero, photographic service bands. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
